sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the remaining semantic and datatype issues. Add sh:datatype xsd:date to firstScheduledDryDockingDate, preserving its conditional optionality. Constrain iceClass to its supplied canonical range nltl:iceClassValue rather than only sh:nodeKind sh:IRI. Gate the mark-to-certificate amidships comparison by the applicable summer-load-line/UIWL and construction/docking marking conditions; the current second SPARQL constraint rejects an out-of-scope ship merely because an optional mark is present with a different value. Preserve the supplied assessmentDate, certificate/document obligations, draught direction, fixed 2007-07-01 cutoff, pre-cutoff docking-date requirement, and complete marking alternatives.
